FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_listti.description: No input parameters are required to list the available ticket boards.

id.description: Opaque board identifier usable for ticket selection.

name.description: Board display name, omitted when not supplied.

columns.description: Available board column metadata when supplied by the provider; omitted when unavailable.

field.description: Board column field identifier usable in selection, filters, or sorting where supported.

items.description: Metadata for an available board column.
An available ticketing board and its supplied metadata.
Available ticket boards in provider order.

tags.instructions: Use this to obtain a board ID for `list-board-tickets`. The tool returns the provider's board collection in one response; it does not run a board or change its conditions.

functions.name: list-ticket-statuses
functions.description: List the ticket statuses available to the connection, including their identifiers and display names.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_listti.description: No input parameters are required to list ticket statuses.

id.description: Opaque ticket status identifier used when creating or updating tickets.

name.description: Status display name; omitted if the provider does not supply one.

items.description: A ticket status available to the connection.
Available ticket statuses in provider order.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_listt.description: Ticket statuses returned in one complete provider response.

tags.instructions: Use this to obtain status IDs before calling `create-ticket` or `update-ticket`. The result is one complete provider response, not a paginated traversal.

functions.name: list-users
functions.description: List NinjaOne users, optionally restricted to technicians or end users, with account-security, device-access, and role information when available.

userType.description: Optional user subtype; omitted requests all users.

includeRoles.description: Request user role names; defaults to false. Missing roles do not mean the user has no roles.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_listus.description: Select the user subtype and whether to request role names.

id.description: Opaque numeric user identifier represented as text.

uid.description: User UUID, distinct from numeric id.

email.description: Account email address without forced case normalization.

roles.description: Reported role names; omitted if not requested or unavailable, distinct from an explicit empty array.

authType.description: Authentication type as reported, such as NATIVE or SSO.

scimUser.description: Whether the account was created by SCIM.

userType.description: Account subtype when known from the source.

administrator.description: Whether the technician is a system administrator.

mfaConfigured.description: Whether at least one MFA method is configured; not a guarantee it is enforced.

organizationId.description: Organization identifier for an end user when supplied.

fullPortalAccess.description: Whether an end user has full portal access.

notifyAllClients.description: Whether the technician receives notifications for all clients; this tool does not configure delivery subscriptions.

assignedDeviceIds.description: Identifiers of devices assigned to this user.

mustChangePassword.description: Whether a password change is required at next login.

accessibleDeviceIds.description: Identifiers of devices the end user can access, distinct from assigned devices.

items.description: A visible NinjaOne login account with the fields available in the selected view.
User accounts returned by the selected provider view.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_listu.description: The complete user collection returned by the selected provider view.

tags.instructions: Use this for NinjaOne login accounts and access auditing. Select userType for technicians or end users; use `list-contacts` for non-account contacts. includeRoles requests role names. The provider returns a collection in one response; there is no documented pagination.

functions.name: search-devices
functions.description: Find devices matching a name, logged-on username, IP address, or other NinjaOne-supported search term.

limit.description: Maximum matches requested; defaults to 100. No continuation is available.

query.description: Search term interpreted by NinjaOne, such as device name, logged-on username, or IP address.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_search.description: Search for devices using a NinjaOne search term and an optional result bound.

displayName.description: Matched device display name when supplied.

ipAddresses.description: Reported IP addresses when included in the search result.

items.description: Reported IP address.

lastLoggedInUser.description: Last reported logged-in username when included.

items.description: A matched device with the fields supplied by NinjaOne.
Device matches returned by the provider; this is not guaranteed to be every match.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_searc.description: One bounded set of device matches in provider order, without a total or continuation.

tags.instructions: Use this when you have a name, username, or IP rather than a device identifier. Use `list-devices` for paginated inventory browsing. Search returns one bounded result set with no documented continuation; refine the query if too broad.

functions.name: send-alert-reset
functions.description: Reset a triggered alert or condition by its UID. This is an operational reset, not deletion of the monitored device.

alertUid.description: UID of the triggered alert or condition to reset.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_sendal.description: The triggered alert or condition to reset.

accepted.description: The provider accepted the reset request; this does not establish that the underlying condition is resolved.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_senda.description: Acceptance receipt for the alert reset, not confirmation of remediation.

tags.instructions: Use an alert UID from `list-alerts` or `list-device-alerts`. Resetting does not fix the underlying condition, which may trigger again. Do not use this to remove a device.

functions.name: send-device-action
functions.description: Submit a built-in action for execution on one device.

runAs.description: Credential role or identifier; omission uses provider selection.

deviceId.description: Opaque decimal target device identifier within signed int32 range.

actionUid.description: UID of the built-in action to execute.

parameters.description: Action-specific parameter text, passed exactly; omitted and empty remain distinct.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_sendde.description: Submit one built-in action to the specified device with optional parameters and credentials.

accepted.description: The provider accepted submission; action execution and success are not established.

deviceId.description: Device targeted by the action submission.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_sendd.description: Submission acceptance for the targeted device and built-in action, not execution completion.

tags.instructions: Use a device ID from `list-devices` and a built-in action UID from NinjaOne's action catalog or administrator. Use `send-device-automation-script` for a script ID. The result is submission acceptance, not completion; an action may disrupt or destructively change the device.

functions.name: send-device-automation-script
functions.description: Submit an available automation script for execution on one device with optional parameters and execution credentials.

runAs.description: Credential role or identifier understood by NinjaOne; omitted leaves credential selection to the provider.

deviceId.description: Opaque decimal target device identifier within signed int32 range.

scriptId.description: Opaque decimal automation-script identifier within signed int32 range.

parameters.description: Script-specific argument text, preserved exactly; omitted uses the provider's default, empty is explicitly supplied.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_sendde.description: One device and available automation script to submit, with optional argument text and execution credentials.

accepted.description: Submission accepted by the provider; execution success and output are not established.

deviceId.description: Device targeted by the script submission.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_sendd.description: Accepted script submission identifiers; does not report execution completion or output.

tags.instructions: Obtain deviceId from `list-devices` and scriptId from `list-automation-scripts`. Use `send-device-action` for a built-in action. Parameters follow the selected script's argument syntax. The tool returns submission acceptance, not script output or completion. Scripts may destructively change the device.

functions.name: send-device-reboot
functions.description: Send a normal or forced restart command to a device. The result establishes command acceptance, not restart completion.

mode.description: Restart mode: normal or forced; forced may interrupt active work.

reason.description: Reason for the restart; omitted means not supplied, empty remains empty.

deviceId.description: Opaque decimal device identifier within signed int32 range.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_sendde.description: Device and restart mode, with an optional reason for the restart.

accepted.description: The provider accepted the command; device restart or availability is not established.

deviceId.description: Device targeted by the restart command.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_sendd.description: Command acceptance only, without confirmation of device restart or availability.

tags.instructions: Obtain deviceId from `list-devices` or `list-organization-devices`. A reboot interrupts device use, especially in forced mode. Choose the mode deliberately. Do not automatically repeat an ambiguous request; check device state and activities first.

functions.name: update-contact
functions.description: Partially update a contact's names, contact information, job title, or organization association.

email.description: New email address; empty is sent for provider validation.

phone.description: New phone number; empty requests clearing.

jobTitle.description: New job title; empty requests clearing.

lastName.description: New family name; empty requests clearing.

firstName.description: New given name; empty requests clearing.

organizationId.description: New organization association, as an opaque decimal int32 identifier.

changes.description: Only supplied properties are changed; null is not supported.

contactId.description: Opaque decimal contact identifier within signed int32 range.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_update.description: Contact identifier and the nonempty set of fields to update.

phone.description: Stored phone number, including empty if cleared.

jobTitle.description: Stored job title, including empty if cleared.

lastName.description: Stored family name, including empty if cleared.

firstName.description: Stored given name, including empty if cleared.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_updat.description: Updated contact fields returned by the provider.

tags.instructions: Obtain contactId from `list-contacts` or `get-contact`. Supply only fields to change. Use `create-contact` for a new record. Empty text requests clearing that value; changing organizationId changes the contact's association.

functions.name: update-device
functions.description: Partially update device information, custom attributes, organization/location assignment, role, policy override, or warranty information.

deviceId.description: Opaque decimal device identifier within signed int32 range.

policyId.description: Policy override identifier within signed int32 range; null removes the override and reverts to organization policy.

userData.description: Complete replacement custom-attribute map; empty requests clearing all attributes.

warranty.description: Partial warranty timestamp changes, with millisecond precision.

endsAt.description: Warranty end instant with explicit offset, at most three fractional second digits.

startsAt.description: Warranty start instant with explicit offset, at most three fractional second digits.

manufacturerFulfilledAt.description: Manufacturer fulfillment instant with explicit offset, at most three fractional second digits; upstream units are provisional.

locationId.description: Location to which the existing device is assigned.

nodeRoleId.description: New device node-role identifier within signed int32 range.

displayName.description: User-assigned display name; empty requests clearing.

organizationId.description: Organization to which the existing device is assigned.

changes.description: Partial device changes; omitted values remain unchanged.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_update.description: Identify an existing device and supply only the device information to change.

accepted.description: The provider accepted the update, not a readback of stored values.

deviceId.description: Identifier of the device whose changes were submitted.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_updat.description: Provider acceptance receipt for the submitted device changes.

tags.instructions: Use a device ID from `list-devices` or `list-organization-devices`. Use `get-device` to inspect current values. Supply only changes; policyId:null reverts to organization policy. Organization and location changes reassign the existing device rather than copying it. For reboot or automation use `send-device-reboot` or `send-device-automation-script`.

functions.name: update-device-custom-fields
functions.description: Partially modify custom-field values on one device without replacing unspecified fields.

additionalProperties.description: Desired typed value for the named custom field.

fields.description: Field names and desired typed values. Omitted names are preserved; null requests clearing the device-local value, subject to field support. Empty text and arrays are not treated as omission.

deviceId.description: Opaque device identifier.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_update.description: Named custom-field values to partially update on one device.

updated.description: The provider accepted the update; this does not assert effective inherited values or return field contents.

deviceId.description: Device for which the provider accepted the field update.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_updat.description: Acceptance receipt for the requested device custom-field update.

tags.instructions: Use a known device ID and configured field names. Read current values with `get-device-custom-fields` first when needed. Only supplied fields change; null requests clearing a local value, while empty strings and arrays are actual values. Field definitions and write permissions still apply. Do not blindly replay an ambiguous write.

functions.name: update-end-user
functions.description: Partially update an end user's name, organization, manager, or full portal access.

managerUid.description: New manager UUID; no manager-clearing representation is established.

organizationId.description: New associated organization identifier within signed int32 range.

fullPortalAccess.description: New full portal access state; false explicitly removes full portal access.

changes.description: Partial changes; omitted fields remain unchanged. Null and name clearing are unsupported.

endUserId.description: Opaque decimal end-user identifier within signed int32 range.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_update.description: The end user to update and the requested partial changes.

roles.description: Role names when supplied by the provider; omission is not an empty role set.

items.description: Provider-supplied role name.

authType.description: Provider authentication type, such as NATIVE or SSO.

mustChangePw.description: Whether next login requires changing password.

mfaConfigured.description: Whether any MFA method is configured.

fullPortalAccess.description: Whether full portal access is granted.

items.description: Opaque assigned-device identifier.
Opaque accessible-device identifier.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_updat.description: The updated end user with available provider-reported account and access fields.

tags.instructions: Get endUserId from `list-end-users` or `list-organization-end-users`. Use `get-end-user` to inspect current access. Supply only changes. fullPortalAccess:false revokes full portal access; it does not delete the account. Email and phone changes are not supported by this tool.

functions.name: update-knowledge-base-article
functions.description: Partially modify an existing knowledge base article's name and/or content while preserving unspecified values.

name.description: Replacement article name; omit to preserve the current name.

content.description: Partial content changes; null is not a clearing instruction.

html.description: Replacement HTML; omit to preserve it, use empty string to clear it.

text.description: Replacement plain text; omit to preserve it, use empty string to clear it.

articleId.description: Opaque identifier of the article to modify.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_update.description: An existing knowledge base article and the name or content representations to replace.

createdAt.description: Creation instant in UTC, preserving source precision.

updatedAt.description: Modification instant in UTC, preserving source precision.

isArchived.description: Provider-returned archive state; this tool does not change it.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_updat.description: The updated knowledge base article returned by the provider.

tags.instructions: Get articleId from `list-knowledge-base-articles` or `get-knowledge-base-article`. Use this for one article; use `batch-update-knowledge-base-articles` for up to 20. Omitted fields are preserved; an empty content string clears that representation. This cannot move, archive or restore an article. Check the article after an ambiguous write before retrying.

functions.name: update-location
functions.description: Partially update an organization's location name, address, description, or custom attributes.

address.description: New address text; empty requests clearing.

userData.description: Complete replacement custom-attribute map; empty requests clearing all attributes.

changes.description: Partial changes; omitted fields remain unchanged and null is unsupported.

locationId.description: Location identifier under this organization within signed int32 range, kept opaque.

organizationId.description: Parent organization identifier within signed int32 range, kept opaque.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_update.description: Organization and location identifiers with only the location values to change.

accepted.description: The provider accepted the update; not a readback of stored values.

organizationId.description: Parent organization of the updated location.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_updat.description: Acceptance receipt for the submitted location update.

tags.instructions: Use organizationId and locationId from `list-organization-locations`. Supply only changes. Use `create-location` for a new location. This does not move the location to another organization or reassign devices.

functions.name: update-organization
functions.description: Partially update an organization's name, description, custom attributes, or device approval mode.

organizationId.description: Opaque decimal organization identifier within signed int32 range.

userData.description: Complete replacement custom-attribute map; empty requests clearing all attributes.

nodeApprovalMode.description: New device admission mode: automatic approval, manual approval, or rejection.

changes.description: Only supplied properties change; null is unsupported.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_update.description: Organization identifier and the organization properties to change.

accepted.description: Provider-confirmed update acceptance, not a stored-value readback.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_updat.description: Receipt confirming provider acceptance of the organization update.

tags.instructions: Get organizationId from `list-organizations` or `get-organization`. Supply only properties to change. Device approval mode affects admission policy. Use `create-organization` for a new organization and `update-location` for an individual location.

functions.name: update-organization-document
functions.description: Partially update one organization document's name, description, or selected template field values.

documentId.description: Opaque decimal document identifier within signed int32 range.

name.description: New document name; empty is sent for provider validation.

fields.description: Field-name to replacement JSON-value map. Empty requests no field changes; an explicit null value requests template-supported clearing.

changes.description: Partial changes; omitted metadata and unnamed fields remain unchanged.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_update.description: An organization document identifier and the partial changes to submit.

updatedFields.description: Only field updates reported by this write, not all document fields.

value.description: Reported updated JSON value; supported explicit null remains null.

items.description: One template field update reported by this write.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_updat.description: The identified updated organization document and its reported field updates.

tags.instructions: Obtain documentId and field names from `list-organization-documents`. Supply only changes; fields updates only named fields. Use `batch-update-organization-documents` for multiple documents. The result's updatedFields is not a full field snapshot.

functions.name: update-ticket
functions.description: Partially modify a ticket's fields, assignments, relationships, recipients, and custom attributes while preserving omitted fields. This does not add a comment.

ticketId.description: Identifier of the ticket to modify; must fit a provider int32.

cc.description: Partial recipient change: omitted subfields stay unchanged, supplied arrays replace a recipient class, and null clears both classes.

emails.description: Replacement CC email addresses; [] or null clears this class.

items.description: CC email address.

userUids.description: Replacement CC user UUIDs; [] or null clears this class.

items.description: CC user UUID.

tags.description: Replacement tags; [] or null clears tags. Omission leaves tags unchanged.

items.description: Ticket tag.

type.description: Replacement ticket category, or null to clear.

subject.description: Replacement subject, including an intentionally empty string.

deviceId.description: Replacement device identifier, or null to clear; must fit int32.

priority.description: Replacement priority; NONE is a named value and null requests clearing.

severity.description: Replacement severity; NONE is distinct from null clearing.

attributes.description: Complete replacement attribute-value collection; [] or null requests clearing all optional values. Include every value to retain.

id.description: Existing attribute-value identifier when available, or null; must fit int32.

value.description: Replacement textual field value; empty string remains an explicit value.

attributeId.description: Form attribute identifier; must fit int32.

items.description: Replacement ticket attribute value.

followupAt.description: Replacement follow-up instant with explicit offset and at most millisecond precision, or null to clear.

locationId.description: Replacement location identifier, or null to clear; must fit int32.

requesterUid.description: Replacement requester UUID, distinct from the user's numeric ID.

ticketFormId.description: Replacement ticket form identifier; must fit int32 and may change form validation requirements.

organizationId.description: Replacement organization identifier; must fit int32.

parentTicketId.description: Replacement parent ticket identifier, or null to remove the relationship; must fit int32.

assignedTechnicianId.description: Replacement primary technician identifier, or null to unassign; must fit int32.

additionalAssignedTechnicianIds.description: Replacement additional technician IDs; [] or null requests clearing the collection.

items.description: Additional technician identifier; must fit int32.

changes.description: Partial modification. Omitted fields remain unchanged; null clears a nullable field, and supplied arrays replace collections.

FunctionInput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_update.description: Identify a ticket and supply only the intended field changes.

id.description: Identifier of the ticket whose update the provider accepted.

FunctionOutput_ninjaone_rmm_oauth2_updat.description: Ticket identity confirmed by the accepted update.

tags.instructions: Use a ticket ID from `get-ticket` or `list-board-tickets`. Supply only fields you intend to change; arrays replace their entire collection and null clears nullable fields. Use `list-ticket-statuses` for status choices. Use `create-ticket-comment` for discussion, tracked comment time, or attachments. Updates can replace existing data and may trigger workflows; after an ambiguous result, inspect `get-ticket` before retrying.
